scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with strictly positive Gram hypotheses, exact branch boundaries and unrestricted uniqueness; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Consistent square nonsingular real systems with unit row norms, positive one-outlier equicorrelations and fixed iid row selection; theorem concerns sharp worst-case one-step expected squared-error progress, not exact multistep MSE, implementation time, or adaptive sampling. Equivalent unindexed E-optimal-design specializations may exist.
title: Exact two-regime E-optimal row sampling for one-outlier equicorrelated systems
